title: Add AGENTS.md for Cursor Cloud development environment
body: ## Summary Adds `AGENTS.md` with Cursor Cloud-specific development instructions for the MIT App Inventor codebase. ## What's included - Environment prerequisites (Java 11, Ant, Google Cloud SDK, Node.js, Firefox, 32-bit libraries) - Build commands (`ant MakeAuthKey`, `ant noplay`) - Dev server startup instructions (`java_dev_appserver.sh`) - Test commands (`ant tests`, `ant BlocklyTest`) - Non-obvious gotchas (GWT compilation time, auth key persistence, iOS skip flag, git submodules) ## Development Environment Verification The following were all verified working: | Check | Status | |-------|--------| | Build (`ant -Dskip.ios=true noplay`) | ✅ Successful (2m 51s) | | Java tests | ✅ All passing | | Blockly/JS tests (136 tests via Karma/Firefox) | ✅ All passing | | Dev server (port 8888) | ✅ Running and serving IDE | | Login + project creation | ✅ Working end-to-end | ## Demo ![App Inventor IDE with HelloWorld project](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-dffd6538-72cf-4647-938e-38e5d9f32255)
